title: Data Parade hosted newsroom and article front end
description: Approved by Ryan 2026-10-21. A hosted Papyrus newsroom for Data Parade (focus: technology for shifting privacy and security left) plus a public front-end stub at dataparade.anth.us that carries only articles (and maybe posts). Domain lives in infra/site.json and may move to a dataparade.io host later. Repo DataParade-io/DataParade-newsroom (private). Hosting in papyrus-production 712236451410, Amplify app d35q7zv4zad2we (dataparade-cms), stack amplify-app-shell-dataparade-cms, standard app shell, Papyrus 5.12.0. Styled from the dataparade.io landing site tokens, fonts and logo (newsroom via Kanbus refined-newsprint token overrides; front end via web/css/site-theme.css). Data Parade is a pending output of the shared relevance Cyclotron (PPY-3212f1, PPY-2d77c8). Out of scope: plugging the stub into the main dataparade.io app; changing that app.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Scope change (Ryan, 2026-10-21, DataParade.anth.us implementation thread): the articles will also be served at dataparade.io/posts by mounting the projection on the dataparade.io CloudFront, so publishing never needs a dataparade.io redeploy. Papyrus side: epic PPY-116551 (urls.basePath, PPY-f8da7a). Data Parade side: PPY-be0f8d (serve under /posts), PPY-b63c46 (mount on dataparade.io, landing reads /posts/_data/latest.json), PPY-e19725 (move the five landing posts). Deploying dataparade.anth.us for testing is in scope; a dataparade.io deploy needs its owner's go-ahead.
